We cut our client's content production time by 40% without hiring.

Here is what changed:

1. One brief template for every post.
Writers stopped guessing what "good" meant.

2. Two publishing days, never more.
Tuesday and Thursday. The calendar stopped slipping.

3. Every post gets repurposed on day one.
One article becomes a LinkedIn post, a thread and a newsletter section.

The result: 8 posts a month, same team, fewer late nights.

What is the one step in your content process you would cut first?

#ContentMarketing #B2BMarketing #Founders
